author: Dana Howl
description:
This video is sponsored by Behaviour Interactive and their game Dead by Daylight! To check it out visit: https://store.steampowered.com/app/381210/Dead_by_Daylight/

In this video, I show you my entire process for hand sculpting and painting a custom figure for the video game Dead by Daylight’s new Diablo themed DLC!

Check out the other two videos from this collaboration with Dead by Daylight as well!!!
